On-Chain Operator. Module 9 · DeFi and grid bots. Navy and cyan. This is the door, not the whole module. Education only.
You already know a grid waits on rungs, and a pool prices a trade with a curve. This module keeps those as two machines.
By the end of the module you will be able to do this: choose the right tool for the market, and run both as one system. Not before. The lessons earn it one page at a time.
The lessons, in order, are 9.0 Mastery Starter, 9.1 Same idea, different machine, 9.2 When each one wins, 9.3 Building a combined system. You do not skip ahead. Each page is the input to the next.
Lesson 9.0, Mastery Starter. Mastery Starter. You will write that down when you get there.

Lesson 9.1, Same idea, different machine. Explain why a concentrated liquidity position and a grid bot are economically close cousins, and where they differ. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 9.2, When each one wins. Pick grid bot, LP, both, or neither, for a given market and account. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 9.3, Building a combined system. Design a portfolio that uses exchange grid bots and DeFi together without doubling up on the same risk. You will write that down when you get there.
